title: Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Bava Kamma 80a for this report, found in [Bava Kamma 80b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.80b.9): “Rabbi Abba bar Pappa said in the name of Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa, who cited Rabbi Acha bar Pappa.” In [Sanhedrin 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.34b.8), “From where do we know this? Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa said,” and so on. In [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.6.1.6), Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdi said in the name of Rabbi Abbahu that the blessing over olive oil is “Who creates the fruit of the tree.” Rabbi Chiyya bar Pappa said before Rabbi Ze’ira, “The Mishnah says so too.”[^1]

notes.text: The named chain is the second of three versions at Bava Kamma 80b. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1240&lang=en) cites all three passages when questioning Maharsha’s proposed correction from Chiyya to Acha in Sanhedrin.
